column2: [intro]
I turn in circles, lost in choices to make
Between the paved paths, I don't know which to take
One day I want to be a pilot, the next a pirate's fate
I can't decide, it only makes me feel great
I leave options open, no clue what the future holds
I juggle possibilities, until the last moment unfolds
Destiny will surprise me, that's for sure, don't know where I'll land
Let's be carried by life, in this world so grand
I tried to be serious, with a well-laid plan
But life always brought unexpected turns, you understand
So why fret, why bind my feet with chains
I prefer keeping my options open, free from all strains
I leave options open, no clue what the future holds
I juggle possibilities, until the last moment unfolds
Destiny will surprise me, that's for sure, don't know where I'll land
Let's be carried by life, in this world so grand
[ solo ]
Life's too short to be bridled, to be confined
So let's follow our desires, let the unexpected unwind
In this dance of chance, let's not be confined
Keep options open, until the last moment defined
[outro]
